hooks.text: 同类卡连续打出可把倍率叠到5倍，低费卡会重置连锁，延长还是打断构成逐回合抉择。
hooks.excerpt: Chain same-type cards to stack a multiplier up to ×5 . Low-cost cards reset the chain — when to extend and when to break is the core turn-by-turn decision.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 迷雾地图从5×5扩张到8×8，战斗、精英、事件、商店、宝箱与灵魂祭坛自由分支。
hooks.excerpt: Maps grow from 5×5 to 8×8 , hidden until explored. Battle, Elite, Event, Shop, Chest, and Soul Altar rooms branch freely — 27+ decision events ensure no two runs share a path.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 构筑层同时提供定向卡牌升级、6类宝石镶嵌、40多件遗物与灵魂祭坛永久成长。
hooks.excerpt: Card Upgrades — pick your target manually, side-by-side before/after preview Gem Socketing — 6 gem types with clear on-card effects Relics — 40+ relics that reshape your build Soul Altar — spend souls for permanent meta-progress
